test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What type of services does NIRTAR provide?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rehabilitation services, education, and research**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swami Vivekanand National Institute of Rehabilitation Training and Research (SVNIRTAR)** is a premier autonomous body under the **Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan)**, which falls under the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment**, Government of India.
 
• The institute is located at **Olatpur**, approximately **30 km** from **Cuttack** and **Bhubaneswar** in **Odisha**. It was originally established as an **Artificial Limbs Centre** in **1975** and later upgraded to a **National Institute** in **1984**.
 
• The core mission of the institute is to provide comprehensive **rehabilitation services**, high-quality **education**, and conduct pioneering **research** in the field of **locomotor disabilities**. Hence, the statement regarding rehabilitation, education, and research is correct.
 
• It functions as a **referral center** for the rehabilitation of persons with locomotor disabilities, providing specialized treatments such as **Physiotherapy**, **Occupational Therapy**, and **Prosthetics and Orthotics**.
 
• The institute maintains a **100-bed hospital** where **reconstructive surgeries** are performed to correct deformities caused by **Polio**, **Cerebral Palsy**, and **congenital anomalies**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Educational Programs:** SVNIRTAR offers several professional undergraduate and postgraduate courses. Key programs include **Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT)**, **Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (BOT)**, and **Bachelor of Prosthetics and Orthotics (BPO)**. It also offers **Post Graduate (DNB/MS)** courses in **Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation (PMR)**.
 
• **Other National Institutes:** The **Government of India** has established several other institutes for different types of disabilities:
 
 
• **NIEPVD (National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities)** located in **Dehradun**.
 
• **AYJNISHD (Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech and Hearing Disabilities)** located in **Mumbai**.
 
• **NIEPMD (National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Multiple Disabilities)** located in **Chennai**.
 
• **PDUNIPPD (Pt. Deendayal Upadhyaya National Institute for Persons with Physical Disabilities)** located in **New Delhi**.
 
 
 
• **Research and Development:** The institute focuses on designing and developing **low-cost aids and appliances** for the disabled. Research is conducted to improve **surgical techniques** and **therapeutic interventions** for better patient outcomes.
 
• **Extension Services:** SVNIRTAR also manages various **Composite Regional Centres (CRCs)** and **District Disability Rehabilitation Centres (DDRCs)** to provide services in rural and remote areas of **India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Legal Framework:** The functioning of such institutes is aligned with the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016**, which ensures the **full and effective participation** and inclusion of persons with disabilities in society.
 
• **Beneficiaries:** The institute serves thousands of patients annually, particularly those from **economically weaker sections**. Many services, including the distribution of **assistive devices** under the **ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances)**, are provided free of cost or at highly subsidized rates.
 
• **Impact:** Through its **human resource development** programs, SVNIRTAR has produced thousands of **rehabilitation professionals** who serve in various hospitals and NGOs across the **globe**.
</ul
